ruleDefinitions.name: User Added to Local Administrators Group
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects addition of users to the local administrator group via "Net" or "Add-LocalGroupMember".

sequences.query: (((process_command_line = RGX(".*localgroup\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/add.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*Add\\-LocalGroupMember\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-Group\\ .*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ administrators\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ administrateur.*")))
